tracks.title: 冇事發生
tracks.subject: A night watchman at a Kwun Tong ice factory writes 'nothing happened' in the logbook, then starts inventing ever wilder entries to stay awake, until the day supervisor reads them aloud.

tracks.title: Kucing Tuan Rumah
tracks.genre: Malay rockabilly (1950s rock and roll revival)
tracks.subject: a tenant in Petaling Jaya who gets fifty ringgit off his rent each month for bathing his landlady's huge, furious Persian cat called Datuk every Saturday

tracks.title: 紙皮箱貓
tracks.subject: a man who spends eight hundred dollars on a fancy padded cat bed, and his cat ignores it to sleep in the cardboard box it was delivered in
